After the second Enter at startup, the screen stayed blank for a few seconds before the trust dialog appeared.
Without being asked, Claude added a regression test for chunk_size=1 and also ran ruff and mypy. This is good behavior, but it went beyond the request and was included in the commit.
Claude clearly said 'Not committed — say the word if you want it committed.' That made the next step easy to see.
